conditions.condition_text: Identify the daily bias by marking out high time frame draws on liquidity.
The daily bias is determined by key levels where price is likely to react.
Wait for price to hit a high time frame draw on liquidity (1H, 4H, or Session High/Low).
Hitting a key level provides the initial opportunity for a reversal.
Scale down to the low time frame (1M or 5M) and look for a reversal using an inverse fair value gap, a break of structure, or a 79% extension closure.
A reversal on the low time frame signals a potential change in trend direction.
Wait for a continuation confluence (fair value gap, equilibrium, breaker block, or order block) on the low time frame.
Continuation confirms the reversal intent and provides a high-probability entry.
Enter the trade on the low time frame continuation confluence.
The combination of HTF bias, LTF reversal, and LTF continuation confirms the entry.

Targets are set at other high time frame draws on liquidity in the opposite direction.
